name: Hera
first: ESA's follow-up to DART — surveying the deflected Didymos asteroid
description: Hera is the European Space Agency's contribution to humanity's first planetary-defence experiment. In 2022 NASA's DART spacecraft deliberately crashed into Dimorphos — the small moon of the asteroid Didymos — and measurably shortened its orbit. Hera, launched in October 2024 on a Falcon 9, is flying to the same binary asteroid (with a 2025 Mars gravity assist en route) to conduct the detailed post-impact survey DART couldn't: the size of the crater, Dimorphos's mass and internal structure, and precisely how much momentum the impact transferred. Together, DART and Hera turn a one-off demonstration into a repeatable, well-characterised deflection technique. Hera carries two CubeSats, Juventas and Milani, for close-up radar sounding and mineralogy.
